source_contract.points: ul.review__points containing exactly three li items
items: 2004–2005: János precíz tervei alapján épült meg a kert, amely cégünk értékrendjét tükrözi.
Több évtizedes gondoskodás: nemcsak az induláskor, hanem a mindennapi fenntartásban és a növények szakszerű ápolásában is hű társunk.
Folyamatos megújulás: János lélegzetelállító formára nyírt növénykülönlegességeivel folyamatosan fejleszti a teret.

target_current_public_DOM: one p.af-review-text containing five span siblings: intro, point1, point2, point3, final; there is no list/listitem markup around the three points
why_this_matters: The visual leaf bullets can be source-like while the accessibility structure still lacks the meaningful 3-item list present in the reference.
safe_future_diagnostic_first: When page256 browser ownership returns, inspect only the active Panasonic review AX subtree and confirm source exposes one list/three listItems while target does not.
Do not rely on whole-page aggregate list counts because shared header/footer differences can compensate unrelated main-content role deltas.

candidate_page256_only_semantic_strategy.goal: Expose one list with three listitems without changing visible text or the Atomic paragraph element type.
possible_shape: Give the second and third point spans stable page256-local IDs and role=listitem through exact match-once edits.

Replace the complete first-point span only if a fresh returned exact snippet fully contains that one span; make it a span role=list owner containing a nested span role=listitem for point1 and aria-owns pointing to point2/point3 IDs.
This keeps intro/final spans outside the list and does not duplicate visible text.
candidate_page256_only_semantic_strategy.warning: This is an ARIA-equivalent candidate, not yet an approved write. Browser AX readback must prove the owned list order/name is source-equivalent and does not disturb paragraph/tabpanel semantics.

abort_if: fresh exact search cannot isolate each point span safely
aria-owns reorders or duplicates AX content unexpectedly
tabPanel accessible name/body reading order changes
acceptance: active Panasonic review exposes exactly one list with exactly three listitems in source order
intro and final testimonial paragraphs remain outside that list in reading order
tab accessible name and panel relationships unchanged
do_not: do not inject block-level ul/li inside the existing rendered p without a proven Atomic tag-owner transformation
do not replace the Atomic review body with a legacy widget/full page save
do not fake a whole-page list count while the review-local subtree remains wrong
